integrity: The all-d theorem is proved with a coordinate normal form and chain-complex calculation. Exact finite computations check, but do not prove, the theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only fields of characteristic two; only folded-cube generating sets with d>=2; no claim of uniformly bounded-degree expander family; possible unindexed coding-theory equivalent; independent audit not performed.
title: Exact characteristic-two square-ideal dimensions for folded-cube evolution algebras
